messages:
Maya: Scheduling a small config-only rollout during the quiet window (2025-11-14 22:00-23:30 UTC). Changes: tenant concurrency cap 12 -> 8, request soft timeout 14s -> 11s, shift 7% traffic to low-latency pool (us-west-2), reduce batch max_tokens 512 -> 320. No model changes.
Liam: Sounds good. Any canary pins?
Maya: Pinning core-analytics and beta-tenant for first 20m. Canary size 0.4% global.
deploy-bot: New deploy queued by Maya. ID: 80012. Window: 2025-11-14 22:00 UTC. Canary targets: gw-usw2-canary-2 x3.
Ivy: Observability prep: latency dashboards up, per-tenant cost tag enabled, alerts on for >30% p95 drift but muted for short flaps. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/d/ops/tinybatch-rollout
Carlos: Rollback criteria proposal: any p95 increase >25% for 10m OR request_errors +0.6% above baseline for 5m OR sustained node OOMs. Also abort if kvcache eviction rate >10% above baseline.
Maya: Add cost spike >20% per-hour for canary tag as a soft rollback trigger. If hit, we scale back batching to previous values before full rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary start -> applying routing and batching patch to gw-usw2-canary-2. Job 80012-step1.
Maya: Canary applied. Initial signals look ok (p50 stable).
Ivy: KV hit rate dropped 90 -> 87% but no latency yet. Batch shrink expected to increase async churn.
Liam: Noted. Watch long-running chat sessions for tail latency.
Ivy: Enabling tracing for top 5 routes now.
Carlos: After 12m, small p95 blip on chat-long (about +12%). Still under rollback threshold.
Maya: Hold and observe for another 10m. If it grows, consider quick kvcache.ttl bump 150s -> 240s.
deploy-bot: staged rollout to 10% started -> job 80012-staged.
Ivy: At 10% p95 drift reduced to +5%, kvcache hit recovering. Good.
Liam: Any cost changes?
Ivy: No measurable cost delta yet.
Maya: Proceed to 30% but keep pinned tenants excluded until 60m.
deploy-bot: expanding to 30% -> job 80012-staged-2. ETA 4m to reweight.
Carlos: Quick note: if we need to revert routing weights only, command is `deployctl set-weights 80012 --rollback-only routing`. Full config rollback: `deployctl rollback 80012`.
Maya: Good to have both paths. I'll annotate release note.
Ivy: At 30% we see slight TTL eviction spike but hit rate back to 89%. p95 stable.
Liam: Suggest we run a micro-tweak: bump kvcache.ttl 180s -> 210s on canary nodes for 5m test, not full rollout. If stable, continue.
Maya: Do it. Keep change scoped to canary.
deploy-bot: Applying patch: kvcache.ttl = 210s to canary.
Ivy: TTL bump applied. Hit rate steadying at 90%. p95 tails receding.
Carlos: No OOMs, no cost spike. Recommend continue to 60%.
Maya: Roll to 60% now. Unpin core-analytics at +45m if stable.
deploy-bot: expanding rollout to 60% -> job 80012-staged-3.
Liam: I'll standby ready to run `deployctl rollback 80012` if any trigger fires.
Ivy: Monitoring: all signals nominal, tracing shows rehydration events but within expected rate.
Maya: Drafting release note: "Config-only maintenance: transient batching and routing tweaks to improve latency under spikes. No API or model changes. Some long sessions may see brief tail latency variance; expected to stabilize within rollout window."
Carlos: Add contact line: reach eng-releases oncall if you see regressions.
Maya: Published note and changelog entry. Holding at 60% for 90m before full expansion.
Liam: Thanks team. If anything pops, @deploy-bot-runner and #eng-oncall are on deck. :thumbsup:
